record.field: Privilege: a user proves who they are for an act they vouch for

A user asked to vouch for a record (an approval, a handover) receives a one-time challenge and, once their proof is accepted, the evidence row that records it. A contact asked to confirm a record receives its messages and answers them from outside, as no user of ours. Nobody holds this privilege as a member: the proof module takes it for the challenges, their messages and evidence it records, for the methods it reads, and for the follow-ups of its own cron, and a user reads back only their own evidence.
